title: The Dunkelflaute (2029)
description: Start at milestone 4 with the green build-out standing: a scripted five-day calm-and-dark episode blankets northwest Europe — hold the lights on with storage, gas and discipline. SAIDI under 30 minutes passes; under 5 is mastery.

economy._rationale: C4 fixture: the post-M3 player has spent ~30 B€ of the M3-era 40 on the build-out; 8 B€ leaves room to operate through the scarcity episode without trivializing the insolvency line (-2 B€).

_why_start_day: 47.9 gives the ungraded cold-start settle stretch before milestone 4's window opens at 48 (the M2 pattern; a recipe start is a legal cold start); the scripted episode runs days 49-54, well inside.
